【AUTO】 [(1)] When a card named "Reunion with Yui" is placed on your climax area, if the number of other 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters in your center stage is two or more, and this card is in your center stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's level 3 or lower characters on the center stage, and put it on the bottom of your opponent's deck.

cards.name: Kirito in the 《Flower Garden》
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card becomes 【REVERSE】 in battle, if the number of other 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters you have is one or less, put this card into your clock.

cards.name: Yui's Simple Answer
cards.text: 【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, this card gets +1000 power.

cards.name: Reseller, Agil
cards.text: 【ACT】【COUNTER】 Backup 2000, Level 1 ［(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room］ (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.)

cards.name: Battle in the Front Lines, Kirito
《The Seed》
cards.text: 【COUNTER】 Choose one of your 《Avatar》 or 《Net》 characters, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn.

cards.name: Confrontation Between the Strongest Players
cards.text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.


(: When this card triggers, you may choose a climax in your waiting room, and return it to your hand.)

cards.name: Reunion with Yui
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, draw a card, choose one of your characters, and that character gets +2000 power and +1 soul until end of turn.
